create_camera_object: create a Camera object with intrinsic matrix K and extrinsic matrix Rt for 3D to 2D projection
convert_world_to_pixel: convert 3D world coordinates to 2D pixel coordinates using the world2pixel function with a KRT matrix
convert_cam_to_pixel: convert camera coordinates to pixel coordinates using cam2pixel with focal length and principal point
factorize_camera_matrix: factorize the Camera projection matrix into K, R, and t components using the factor method
flip_tensor_along_dims: flip a PyTorch tensor along specified dimensions using the flip function with multi_meshgrid indexing
